collection: Hayom Yom original-language daily entries (Hebrew, Yiddish and mixed Hebrew/Yiddish) plus one in-place locator enrichment of a canonical Hebrew correspondence item.
source_authority: Chabad.org / TheRebbe.org, Sichos in English Collection; AID 1273962 canonical correspondence page.
review_method: Direct public web.open inspection of nine item-level Hayom Yom pages in original Hebrew/Yiddish plus one reopened canonical Hebrew correspondence body (AID 1273962) to add exact per-proposition locators. Search extracts were not used as content.

blocked_candidates.reason: The public web reader returned Internal Error and no readable item-level source body on 2026-11-15. Earlier runs recorded a navigation/summary shell. No runner-side crawler retry or access-control bypass was attempted.

fallback_source_results.source: Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org Hayom Yom original-language item pages
fallback_source_results.result: Nine accessible original-language entries were opened and used as fallback after AID 4666220 returned an Internal Error. Six entries are Hebrew, two Yiddish and one mixed Hebrew/Yiddish.

limitations: The nine new records are separate dated anthology entries, not nine witnesses to one event or one proposition.
Same-page English renderings are not independent witnesses; no English translation was added as a separate identity.
Embedded teachings remain attributed to the Alter Rebbe, Rebbe Rashab or Rebbe Rayatz where the page says so; no AI inference is attributed to the Rebbe.
The entries remain Parsed; no first edition, manuscript, autograph, recording or underlying cited letter was inspected.
AID 4666220 was blocked in the public reader; nine other item-level entries were opened as same-run fallback.
